rationale: The added jobs expression/partial indexes, usage_ledger timestamp index, and event_log (kind, ts) plus partial (job_id, ts) indexes do not change table data or application semantics. Existing application and PostgreSQL images can continue operating after this schema is applied; they ignore the additional indexes. Event retention prunes transient telemetry kinds with a DELETE rather than a migration, so it introduces no rollback coupling either. Destructive or version-coupled migrations must use mode manual-forward-only and are ineligible for automatic rollback deployment.
